name: SideNavFooter

props.name: assistiveText
props.description: Provide text to be read to screen readers and shown as a tooltip when interacting with the toggle button in the footer

props.name: expanded
props.description: Specify whether the side navigation is expanded or collapsed

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon SideNavFooter rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
